t: Woodchucks Wood - Overview, News & Similar companies | ZoomInfo.com
s: Woodchucks Wood specializes in providing a wide range of lumber products, including thick and thin boards, tailored for various woodworking and crafting needs. They offer both domestic and exotic wood species, such as Walnut, Maple, and Cedar, sourced from Amish mills.

Woodchucks Wood is based in north central Wisconsin....Granton, to be exact. We are a family operation, in the middle of a large Amish community. We appreciate the Amish, and work with them as much as possible. Many of them are woodworkers, just like us, and so we buy most of our lumber from them.

A great value option for getting a lot of wood all at once! These come in 12", 16", or 24" lengths and a mix of species or solid species boxes are available also. Some boxes contain "perfect" S4S lumber, and some have "scrap" wood.
